[
  {
    "id": "U25",
    "path": "excalidraw-app/data/index.ts",
    "action": "edit",
    "phase": "codegen",
    "behaviour": "Extends collaboration socket payload types with optional pages and pageId fields.",
    "rules": [
      "1. Import ExcalidrawPage from \"@excalidraw/element/types\".",
      "2. Add pages?: readonly ExcalidrawPage[] to SocketUpdateDataSource[\"SCENE_INIT\"][\"payload\"] and SocketUpdateDataSource[\"SCENE_UPDATE\"][\"payload\"].",
      "3. Add pageId?: string to SocketUpdateDataSource[\"MOUSE_LOCATION\"][\"payload\"] and SocketUpdateDataSource[\"USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS\"][\"payload\"]."
    ],
    "sites": [
      {
        "id": "S1",
        "at": "replace",
        "from": 19,
        "to": 23,
        "first_line": "import type {",
        "last_line": "} from \"@excalidraw/element/types\";",
        "rule": "Import ExcalidrawPage from \"@excalidraw/element/types\"."
      },
      {
        "id": "S2",
        "at": "replace",
        "from": 83,
        "to": 112,
        "first_line": "SCENE_INIT: {",
        "last_line": "};",
        "rule": "Add pages?: readonly ExcalidrawPage[] to SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE payloads and pageId?: string to MOUSE_LOCATION and USER_VISIBLE_SCENE_BOUNDS payloads."
      }
    ],
    "depends_on": [
      "U02",
      "U07"
    ],
    "covers": [
      "NFR-2"
    ],
    "checks": [
      "eslint"
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "U26",
    "path": "excalidraw-app/collab/Portal.tsx",
    "action": "edit",
    "phase": "codegen",
    "behaviour": "Includes pages in scene broadcast payloads and activePageId in mouse location and visible scene bounds payloads.",
    "rules": [
      "1. In broadcastScene, read const appState = this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getAppState() and include pages: appState.pages in data.payload when appState.pages is non-empty.",
      "2. In broadcastMouseLocation and broadcastVisibleSceneBounds, include pageId: this.collab.excalidrawAPI.getAppState().activePageId in data.payload."
